About.title: Construire la bourse de prédiction la plus fiable au monde
About.paragraph1: ITRADE a été fondé en 2026 à Johannesburg avec une mission simple : donner à chacun accès à la sagesse des foules, exprimée sous forme de probabilités en temps réel sur les événements qui comptent.
About.paragraph2: Nous croyons que les marchés de prédiction sont la forme la plus honnête de prévision — les traders mettent leur argent là où se trouvent leurs convictions, créant des signaux transparents, opportuns et impossibles à falsifier.

HowItWorks.label: PLATFORM
HowItWorks.title: How ITRADE works
HowItWorks.paragraph1: Browse live markets on real-world events, then buy YES or NO shares at the current market price. Prices move between 0¢ and 100¢ and reflect the crowd’s implied probability.
HowItWorks.paragraph2: If you are right when the market resolves, each winning share pays out $1. If you are wrong, shares settle at $0. You can also sell before resolution to lock in a gain or cut a loss.
HowItWorks.paragraph3: Funding, order matching, and settlement are handled on-platform with clear fees and public market data so you always know where you stand.

Fees.label: PLATFORM
Fees.title: Transparent trading fees
Fees.paragraph1: ITRADE keeps pricing simple: deposits are free, and trading fees are a small percentage of the notional value of each fill. There are no hidden spreads baked into the quoted price beyond the live order book.
Fees.paragraph2: Withdrawal fees, if any, are shown before you confirm a payout. Resolved markets settle without an extra resolution charge — winners receive the full $1 per share less any fee already taken on the trade.
Fees.paragraph3: Fee schedules can change as we expand products; the rate that applies is always the one displayed at the time of your order.

Liquidity.label: PLATFORM
Liquidity.title: Deep, continuous liquidity
Liquidity.paragraph1: Prediction markets only work when you can enter and exit at fair prices. ITRADE combines trader-to-trader matching with incentives that keep books tight across popular categories.
Liquidity.paragraph2: Open interest, recent volume, and spread are visible on every market card so you can judge depth before you trade. Thin markets are labeled clearly — we do not hide illiquidity behind optimistic quotes.
Liquidity.paragraph3: As volume grows, we continue to refine market-making programs and listing standards to keep spreads competitive for both retail and professional traders.

Api.label: PLATFORM
Api.title: Build on the ITRADE API
Api.paragraph1: Our public API is designed for market data, order placement, and account reads with the same rules that power the web app. Authenticated endpoints use scoped keys so you only grant the access you need.
Api.paragraph2: Use streaming or polling feeds for prices and fills, then reconcile against the ledger endpoints for balances and settlements. Rate limits and versioning are documented so integrations stay stable.
Api.paragraph3: API access is rolling out in stages. Request credentials from your account settings when available, or contact us if you are building a production integration.

Careers.label: COMPANY
Careers.title: Build the future of forecasting
Careers.paragraph1: ITRADE is hiring people who care about markets, product craft, and regulated finance. We are a small team in Johannesburg shipping a high-integrity prediction exchange for Africa and beyond.
Careers.paragraph2: Roles span engineering, design, market operations, compliance, and growth. We value clear writing, ownership, and traders’ trust over vanity metrics.
Careers.paragraph3: If that sounds like you, send a short note and CV via the Contact page and tell us what you want to work on.

Press.label: COMPANY
Press.title: Press and media
Press.paragraph1: Journalists and analysts covering prediction markets, fintech, or South African capital markets can request product briefings, founder interviews, and approved assets.
Press.paragraph2: We share high-level volume and open-interest figures when they help the public understand the product — never customer-identifying trading data.
Press.paragraph3: For embargoed announcements or logo usage, reach out through the Contact page with your outlet, deadline, and topic.

Contact.label: COMPANY
Contact.title: Get in touch
Contact.paragraph1: Questions about your account, a market resolution, or platform access should start from the signed-in help flows whenever possible — that is the fastest path to the right team.
Contact.paragraph2: For partnerships, careers, press, and compliance inquiries, email the team listed in your account statements or regulatory disclosures, and include enough context for us to route your message.
Contact.paragraph3: We aim to acknowledge non-urgent requests within two business days. Trading emergencies should use in-app support so we can verify your identity securely.

Disclaimer.label: LEGAL
Disclaimer.title: Risk disclaimer
Disclaimer.paragraph1: Prediction market trading involves risk of loss. Past prices and volumes are not guarantees of future results. You should only trade with funds you can afford to lose.
Disclaimer.paragraph2: ITRADE does not provide investment, legal, or tax advice. Market resolutions follow published rules for each event; edge cases may require administrator judgment consistent with those rules.
Disclaimer.paragraph3: Access may be restricted by jurisdiction. It is your responsibility to understand local laws before opening an account or placing orders.

Terms.label: LEGAL
Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.paragraph1: By creating an account or using ITRADE, you agree to trade under our platform rules, fee schedule, and market-specific resolution criteria. You must be eligible under applicable law and provide accurate identity information when required.
Terms.paragraph2: We may suspend markets, cancel clearly erroneous trades, or limit accounts to protect market integrity and comply with regulation. Client funds are handled according to our published custody and segregation practices.
Terms.paragraph3: These pages summarize key points; the binding terms are the full legal agreements presented at signup and updated from time to time with notice in-product.

Admin.payoutsDescription: Les marchés binaires se règlent à 1 $ par part gagnante. Cette page explique comment les achats, ventes et résolutions déplacent les soldes et les écritures du grand livre — les mêmes règles qu’à la résolution.
Admin.payoutsBuyBody: Dépenser de l’argent pour acquérir des parts OUI ou NON au prix actuel de l’issue. Le solde est débité du montant en dollars.
Admin.payoutsBuyFormula: parts = montant ÷ prix · solde −= montant · grand livre trade_buy
Admin.payoutsSellBody: Sortir tôt en revendant les parts détenues au prix actuel. Le solde est crédité ; les parts nettes sur cette issue diminuent.
Admin.payoutsSellFormula: parts ≈ montant ÷ prix · solde += montant · grand livre trade_sell · parts nettes ↓
Admin.payoutsResolveBody: Un admin choisit le côté gagnant (OUI ou NON). Chaque utilisateur avec des parts nettes positives de ce côté reçoit 1 $ par part. Les parts perdantes paient 0 $ — pas de débit supplémentaire ; le coût a déjà été payé à l’achat.
Admin.payoutsResolveFormula: paiement = 1 $ × max(0, parts nettes gagnantes) · grand livre market_win
Admin.payoutsHouseBody: Vue admin optionnelle : la colonne Profit d’Admin marchés estime le P&L si OUI ou NON gagne. C’est achats − ventes − paiements aux gagnants.
Admin.payoutsHouseFormula: profit = Σ achats − Σ ventes − Σ paiements gagnants
Admin.payoutsExamplesIntro: Supposons que OUI commence à 40 ¢ (0,40 $). Les chiffres ignorent le léger impact de prix pour garder le calcul clair.
Admin.payoutsExample1Title: Alice achète OUI — le marché résout OUI
Admin.payoutsExample1Step1: Alice achète 40 $ de OUI à 40 ¢ → 40 ÷ 0,40 = 100 parts OUI. Solde −40 $ (trade_buy).
Admin.payoutsExample1Step2: Elle conserve jusqu’à la résolution (pas de ventes).
Admin.payoutsExample1Step3: L’admin résout OUI. Parts nettes gagnantes = 100 → paiement 100 $ (market_win).
Admin.payoutsExample2Title: Même achat — le marché résout NON
Admin.payoutsExample2Step1: Alice achète encore 40 $ de OUI à 40 ¢ → 100 parts OUI. Solde −40 $.
Admin.payoutsExample2Step2: L’admin résout NON. Les parts OUI d’Alice sont perdantes.
Admin.payoutsExample2Step3: Paiement = 0 $. Pas de crédit market_win pour Alice.
Admin.payoutsExample2Result: P&L d’Alice : −40 $. (Bob, s’il détenait NON, serait payé 1 $ × ses parts nettes NON.)
Admin.payoutsExample3Title: Acheter puis vendre avant la résolution
Admin.payoutsExample3Step2: Plus tard OUI cote 60 ¢. Elle vend tout ≈ 60 $ (trade_sell). Parts nettes OUI → 0.
Admin.payoutsExample3Step3: Elle a verrouillé le mark-to-market : −40 $ + 60 $ = +20 $ déjà en cash.
Admin.payoutsExample3Step4: À la résolution (OUI ou NON), aucun paiement de résolution — parts nettes gagnantes = 0.
Admin.payoutsExample3Result: Vendre sort de la position tôt. La résolution ne paie que les parts nettes restantes du côté gagnant.
